resources.string: Theme, language and privacy
Open this menu to choose the app theme or language and to view the Privacy Policy.
Bluetooth protection
This button enables or disables Bluetooth protection. Before setup is complete, it refreshes the device status.
Return to Cover Mode
Return to your selected Cover Mode with this button.
Quick access
Add the Bluetooth Disable tile to Quick Settings for access without the launcher icon.
App icon and Cover Mode
Choose the launcher icon and set up a Cover Mode here.

Use the Updates tab in the bottom bar to check for a new version.
